# Preserved dependencies

Copied for the local SOD subscription preview from the exact resources used by
the existing `sod/index.html`. No library upgrade is included.

- GSAP 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js
- ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Inter, Newsreader and JetBrains Mono: Google Fonts CSS endpoint already used
  by the original page, with the returned font files hosted locally here.
- Font licenses: upstream `google/fonts` OFL directories for `inter`,
  `newsreader` and `jetbrainsmono`. Only whitespace and line endings normalized.
- Brand mark: existing `assets/sneferu-mark-on-light.svg`, unchanged.

GSAP's copyright and license URL remain in the headers of both library files.
